blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police-Anti-Cybercrime Group (PNP-ACG) urged the public to remain vigilant when transacting with online sellers, particularly as shoppers increasingly turn to online platforms to purchase gifts for the upcoming holiday season. Based on data shared at a press briefing on Wednesday, online selling scams ranked first among cybercrime cases, with authorities logging 743 cases of online selling fraud from January to October 2026. “If possible, since online selling scams are the number one type of online fraud, we should opt for cash only,” said PNP-ACG spokesperson Lt.
